_comment: Example shape only. Not a committed blueprint, and not wired to ledger.py yet. Copy to pt01-001.json and fill in real values once the target is actually running, then this file stops being an example.

target._comment: Must resolve to localhost, 127.0.0.1, or a service name in this repo's own docker-compose file. ledger.py refuses any other host before a replay runs.

auth._comment: Two local accounts created inside the container for this test only, never real credentials.

attack_variant._comment: Request the attacker account's token but a basket_id belonging to the victim account.

legitimate_check._comment: Same endpoint, same account, basket_id belongs to the requester. Must keep succeeding in every condition.
